How to Read a Turkish Court Citation

A Yargıtay citation names the court or chamber, an esas (E.) number, a karar (K.) number and a date. Match all of them before you rely on a decision.

Published
24 Nov 2026
Updated
24 Nov 2026
Author
MESA contributors
Reading time
6 minutes
On this page
  1. What does a Yargıtay citation contain?

Short answer

Read the court or chamber first, then the esas (E.) number, then the karar (K.) number, then the decision date. Two decisions can share a number in different chambers or years, so all parts must match.

What does a Yargıtay citation contain?#

A Yargıtay citation (künye) identifies one decision with four parts: the court or chamber, the esas number, the karar number and the decision date. A complete example from an official decision text is:

Example

Yargıtay Ceza Genel Kurulu, 2017/885 E., 2021/693 K., 29.12.2021

Not legal advice

This guide explains how to read and check official sources. It is not legal advice. For a decision that affects rights or deadlines, consult a qualified lawyer.

What does each part mean?#

PartIn the exampleWhat it tells you
Court or chamberCeza Genel KuruluWhich body decided. Chambers are numbered, such as 12. Ceza Dairesi or 3. Hukuk Dairesi.
Esas number (E.)2017/885The file number: the year the file was registered and its sequence number.
Karar number (K.)2021/693The decision number: the year of the decision and its sequence number.
Date29.12.2021The day of the decision. The text above ends with “29.12.2021 tarihinde yapılan müzakerede oy birliğiyle karar verildi”.

Numbers are counted per court or chamber, so 2017/885 E. can exist in many chambers. Never match on one number alone.

Which abbreviations appear most often?#

AbbreviationMeaning
HGKHukuk Genel Kurulu (Civil General Assembly)
CGKCeza Genel Kurulu (Criminal General Assembly)
İBKİçtihadı Birleştirme Kurulu (Assembly for unifying case law)
E. / K.Esas / Karar
HD / CDHukuk Dairesi / Ceza Dairesi, as in 3. HD or 12. CD

How do short forms and earlier decisions appear?#

Decision texts often refer to earlier decisions in a shorter form. These lines come from the same official texts:

  • Kararı veren Yargıtay Dairesi: 12. Ceza Dairesi and Sayısı: 131-288 give the chamber and the numbers of the earlier decision under review, without years.
  • 20.02.2019 tarih ve 84-14 sayı ile refers to a decision by date and short numbers.
  • 28/11/2017 gün ve 2016/1307 Esas, 2017/9551 Karar spells the words out instead of using E. and K.

A short form is not enough to find a decision. Use it to locate the full citation in the decision text.

How do you check a citation?#

  1. Write down the court or chamber, E. number, K. number and date exactly as given.
  2. Search for the decision in Yargıtay Karar Arama or UYAP Emsal.
  3. Confirm that all four parts match the decision you found.
  4. Read the full text and check that it supports the claim.

The guide on verifying an AI-cited Yargıtay decision covers the full process. Common AI citation errors shows what usually goes wrong.

What can MESA do with citations?#

MESA 0.9.4 recognizes decision references in Turkish text. In our labeled test it found all 38 labeled decision references across 150 chunks, with no false positives. It does not check whether a decision exists or supports a claim. See how the extraction was measured.

Sources#

  1. Yargıtay Karar Arama
  2. UYAP Emsal Karar Arama
  3. Yargıtay
